place_fields.summary: Namdroling Monastery, also known as the Golden Temple, is a prominent monastery in Bylakuppe known for Tibetan Buddhist architecture, richly detailed interiors, and large golden statues.

planning_attributes.description: Namdroling Monastery is the most prominent monastery and temple attraction in Bylakuppe, also known as the Golden Temple; its interiors contain towering golden statues of Buddha, Padmasambhava, and Amitayus.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: Bylakuppe is accessible by road; the nearest railway station is in Mysore, and Mysore Airport is approximately 80 km away.

place_fields.summary: Hoysaleswara Temple in Halebidu is a 12th-century Shaiva temple of the Hoysala Empire, noted for its double-shrine design and intricate soapstone carvings.

planning_attributes.description: Hoysaleswara Temple is a 12th-century Hoysala temple dedicated to Lord Shiva, built by King Vishnuvardhana and later rulers and known for detailed carvings.
planning_attributes.legend_or_history: The temple was built in the 12th century during the Hoysala Empire; the GitHub source identifies King Vishnuvardhana and later rulers as builders and describes it as a Hoysala architectural masterpiece.
